def transform(grid):
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    panel = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    out = [list(row) for row in zip(*panel)]
    # The outside markers specify the color correspondence for the design.
    outside = [v for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row)
               if v not in (0, 1) and not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1)]
    if 3 not in outside and 2 in outside:
        out = [[({2: 3, 3: 2}.get(v, v)) for v in row] for row in out]
    return out
